summary: Split 3b: move the item tooltip out of draw_objects
author: pm
body:
`screen_on_game_draw_objects.cpp` draws an item tooltip inside the world pass; move it to the screen-pass tooltip layer. Crusade markers stay in the world.

**Done when:** tooltip draws in screen space at the cursor; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.
